workflow_source.text:
name: installer engine

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  core:
    name: core (${{ matrix.runner }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04
            target: linux/amd64
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04-arm
            target: linux/arm64
          - runner: macos-26
            target: darwin/arm64
          - runner: windows-2025
            target: windows/amd64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Existing checks, manager fixtures, released migration and vendor retirement.
    timeout-minutes: 150
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Verify actual native runner target
        run: test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = '${{ matrix.target }}'
      # Run before any other installer fixture: Windows uses real known folders,
      # and the keyboard journey requires an actually absent installer state.
      - name: Exercise the public keyboard installation and personal-data journey
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_PUBLIC_UI: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_UI_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/dotfiles-public-ui-evidence
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go test -v -count=1 -timeout 25m -run '^TestNativePublicInteractiveLifecycle$' ./terminal
      - name: Preserve public keyboard acceptance evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: public-ui-${{ matrix.runner }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dotfiles-public-ui-evidence/*.terminal.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dotfiles-public-ui-evidence/installer-state.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Install shell test prerequisites
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends zsh tmux
      - name: Establish trusted disposable completion directories
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: bash ../scripts/prepare-disposable-linux-host.sh shell
      - name: Install tmux integration test prerequisite
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          # This supplies the fixture executable; native tmux provisioning is
          # tested separately when its production package provider is connected.
          if ! command -v tmux >/dev/null; then
            HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP=1 brew install tmux
          fi
      - name: Check formatting and dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          formatting=$(gofmt -l .)
          if [[ -n "$formatting" ]]; then
            printf 'Files requiring gofmt:\n%s\n' "$formatting"
            exit 1
          fi
          go mod tidy
          git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
      - name: Vet and exercise the engine against the native filesystem
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go vet ./...
          go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30m -v ./...
      - name: Exercise process-consumer reads with native root permissions
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go test -c -race -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/legacy-process.test" .
          sudo -n "$RUNNER_TEMP/legacy-process.test" -test.v -test.count=1 -test.timeout=2m \
            -test.run='^TestLegacyLinux(Process|Closed|Kernel|Reader(Reports|Refuses|Handle|Inspects|Worker))'
      - name: Edit a root-owned file through sudoedit and the generated editor
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_SUDO_EDITOR: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 2m -run '^TestNativeSudoEditorUsesGeneratedNeovim$' .
      - name: Install, execute, check and remove the real pinned archive
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_ARCHIVES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_PUBLIC_WINDOWS: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNativeArchive' ./...
      - name: Install, check and remove the pinned Sentinel commit, and hand over from v1.0.0
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Linux' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_SENTINEL: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNativeSentinel' .
      - name: Install, consume, check, update and remove T3 Code and the Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Kiro CLIs
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_AGENT_CLIS: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNativeAgentCLIInstalledApplicationLifecycle$' .
      - name: Verify native APT transaction and removal contracts
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Linux' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNative(APT|LinuxAPT)' .
      - name: Verify native Homebrew transaction and removal contracts
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNative(Brew|HomebrewIdentitySurvivesVolumeRemount)' .
      - name: Install, contact, update and remove the real Tailscale daemon
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Linux' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_TAILSCALE: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestNativeTailscalePackageLifecycle$' .
      - name: Verify Windows runtime registration and Microsoft signature
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_NATIVE_WINDOWS_VENDOR: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 8m -run '^TestWindows(VendorNativeRegistrationAndSignature|BuildToolsNativeReuseAndEnvironment)$' .
      - name: Install, use and remove the private language prerequisites
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_LANGUAGE_PREPARATION: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestNative((Latex|Rust|Yamllint)Preparation|WindowsPipConfigurationIsolation$|NodeConsumerPreservesPayloadAndRemoval$)' .
      - name: Install, upgrade, use and remove full Windows Git and GNU Make
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_NATIVE_WINDOWS_GIT_MAKE: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNativeWindowsGitAndMakeLifecycle$' .
      - name: Install and remove the locked Neovim runtime
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NVIM_SYNC_BOOTSTRAP: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNativeNvimSyncCompleteBootstrap$' .

      - name: Verify public POSIX bootstrap and legacy migration lifecycle
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os != 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_PUBLIC_POSIX_BOOTSTRAP: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNativePOSIXPublicBootstrapMigrationSetupLifecycle$' .

      - name: Verify public PowerShell bootstrap and legacy migration lifecycle
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_PUBLIC_WINDOWS_MIGRATION: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNativeWindowsPublicMigrationSetupLifecycle$' .


      - name: Verify native legacy package-manager retirement
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_MANAGERS: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_INVENTORY: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestLegacy(Windows|Chocolatey|Winget|Homebrew|WezTerm|MacApplication)' .

      - name: Migrate and retire the published POSIX installation
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os != 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_RETIREMENT: '1'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${{ runner.os }}" == Linux ]]; then
            go test -v -count=1 -timeout 60m -run '^TestNativeLegacyRetirementLinuxReleasedSetup$' .
          else
            go test -v -count=1 -timeout 60m -run '^TestNativeLegacyRetirementDarwinReleasedSetup$' .
          fi

      - name: Install and retire Determinate through its validated vendor receipt
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os != 'Windows' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_DETERMINATE: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestNativeLegacyDeterminate(Upstream)?Retirement$' .

  neovim-lifecycle:
    name: Neovim lifecycle (${{ matrix.runner }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04
            target: linux/amd64
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04-arm
            target: linux/arm64
          - runner: macos-26
            target: darwin/arm64
          - runner: windows-2025
            target: windows/amd64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      DOTFILES_TEST_NVIM_APPLICATION: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Verify actual native runner target
        run: test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = '${{ matrix.target }}'
      - name: Install, consume, update and remove the complete Neovim selection
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 80m -run '^TestNativeNeovimInstalledApplicationLifecycle$' .

  desktop-lifecycle:
    name: Desktop lifecycle (${{ matrix.runner }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04
            target: linux/amd64
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04-arm
            target: linux/arm64
          - runner: macos-26
            target: darwin/arm64
          - runner: windows-2025
            target: windows/amd64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 100
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      DOTFILES_NATIVE_DESKTOP_FONTS: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Verify actual native runner target
        run: test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = '${{ matrix.target }}'
      - name: Prepare disposable Linux display and native font inspection
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends xvfb xauth dbus-x11 x11-utils libglib2.0-bin fontconfig pango1.0-tools apt-utils xterm xdotool
      # The hosted image deliberately chmods /usr/share 0777. A writable
      # system parent is not an acceptable production installation boundary.
      - name: Establish trusted disposable system parent
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: bash ../scripts/prepare-disposable-linux-host.sh desktop
      - name: Verify native X window disappearance and query failures
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          DOTFILES_NATIVE_XWINDOW: '1'
        run: xvfb-run -a go test -v -count=1 -timeout 1m -run '^TestNativeDesktopXWindowBoundary$' .
      - name: Verify pinned Code native ownership and repository preservation
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_CODE: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestNativeLinuxCodeDEBLifecycle$' .
      - name: Install, render, check and remove native fonts
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 12m -run '^TestNativeFontInstallConsumeRemove$' .
      - name: Remove an earlier private Obsidian Flatpak and move to the portable build
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_FLATPAK: '1'
        run: dbus-run-session -- go test -v -count=1 -timeout 25m -run '^TestNativeFlatpakApplicationLifecycle$' .
      - name: Consume scoped Windows Terminal settings and verify removal
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_WINDOWS_TERMINAL: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^TestNativeWindowsTerminalConsumesScopedSettingsAndExits$' .
      # Root creates the virtual keyboard, reads xremap's output and installs
      # the real session rule on this disposable host.
      - name: Remap a Mac keyboard in identified windows, then remove it
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_KEYBOARD: '1'
        run: |
          test -c /dev/uinput || sudo modprobe uinput
          go test -c -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" .
          xvfb-run -a sh -c 'sudo --preserve-env=DISPLAY,XAUTHORITY,DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_KEYBOARD "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" -test.v -test.count=1 -test.timeout=20m -test.run "^TestNativeMacKeyboardLifecycle$"'
      - name: Load pinned Ghostty against the oldest supported Ubuntu libraries
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_GHOSTTY_RELEASES: '1'
          GHOSTTY_OLDEST_UBUNTU_IMAGE: ubuntu:24.04@sha256:68ee22004a9109b44973313b02ff7b1de250f1de0f5ecb628d73f579aaff33ac
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNativeGhosttyLoadsOnOldestSupportedUbuntu$' .

      # Linux applications run under Ubuntu's stock AppArmor user-namespace
      # restriction, which the hosted image relaxes (Obsidian report 2026-10-22).
      - name: Launch configured desktop applications and verify update/removal
        env:
          DOTFILES_NATIVE_DESKTOP: '1'
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ runner.os }}" == Linux ]]; then
            bash ../scripts/prepare-disposable-linux-host.sh userns
            dbus-run-session -- xvfb-run -a go test -v -count=1 -timeout 70m -run '^TestNativeDesktopInstalledApplicationLifecycle$' .
          else
            go test -v -count=1 -timeout 70m -run '^TestNativeDesktopInstalledApplicationLifecycle$' .
          fi
      - name: Verify Mac disk-image transport and strict vendor signatures
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_DESKTOP_ARCHIVES: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^Test(NativeDMGPreservesBundleFilesWithoutSyntheticAppleDouble|NativeDesktopArchiveLifecycles)$' .

  fresh-homebrew:
    name: Fresh Homebrew (macOS arm64)
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Prepare an actually absent Homebrew prefix on this disposable runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" = true
          test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
          test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = darwin/arm64
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go -C installer test -c -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" .
          if [[ -e /opt/homebrew ]]; then
            test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/preinstalled-homebrew"
            sudo mv /opt/homebrew "$RUNNER_TEMP/preinstalled-homebrew"
          fi
          test ! -e /opt/homebrew
          # This job proves fresh Homebrew with the runner's Apple toolchain.
          # Fresh Command Line Tools provisioning has a separate fixture.
      - name: Bootstrap and verify retained infrastructure through the production worker
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_HOMEBREW_BOOTSTRAP: '1'
        run: '"$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" -test.v -test.timeout=30m -test.run="^TestNativeHomebrewBootstrapFreshLifecycle$"'

  fresh-debian-apt:
    name: Fresh Debian APT (${{ matrix.arch }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04
            arch: amd64
          - runner: ubuntu-26.04-arm
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    container:
      image: debian:13-slim@sha256:62bd423aeee912639ca8ee681c2b762cb3e25137e0a92b20be455898a9f034ad
      options: --cap-add SYS_PTRACE
    # APT/editor acceptance, single-user migration and the no-init vendor lifecycle.
    timeout-minutes: 185
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
      DOTFILES_TEST_LINUX_FRESH: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Prepare the disposable Linux test host
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          apt-get -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update
          apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Exercise the native provider and installed application as root without sudo
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = 'linux/${{ matrix.arch }}'
          test "$(id -u)" = 0
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
          go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 20m -run '^TestNativeLinuxAPT' .
      - name: Install, consume, update and remove Neovim from absent Mason prerequisites
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NVIM_APPLICATION: '1'
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout 80m -run '^TestNativeNeovimInstalledApplicationLifecycle$' .

      - name: Prepare a separate account for single-user Nix migration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          apt-get -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update
          apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git sudo xz-utils bzip2 procps python3 python3-venv
          useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash dotfiles-migration
          printf '%s\n' 'dotfiles-migration ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/dotfiles-migration
          chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/dotfiles-migration
          visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/dotfiles-migration
          go -C installer test -c -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/retirement.test" .
      - name: Migrate and retire a real single-user Nix installation
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_RETIREMENT: '1'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo -n --preserve-env=PATH,GOTOOLCHAIN,GH_TOKEN,DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES,DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_RETIREMENT -u dotfiles-migration \
            env HOME=/home/dotfiles-migration USER=dotfiles-migration LOGNAME=dotfiles-migration \
            GOPATH=/home/dotfiles-migration/go GOCACHE=/home/dotfiles-migration/.cache/go-build \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/retirement.test" -test.v -test.timeout=60m -test.run='^TestNativeLegacyRetirementLinuxSingleUserReleasedSetup$'

      - name: Verify Determinate retirement without an init system
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_DETERMINATE: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo -n --preserve-env=PATH,GOTOOLCHAIN,DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES,DOTFILES_TEST_LEGACY_DETERMINATE -u dotfiles-migration \
            env HOME=/home/dotfiles-migration USER=dotfiles-migration LOGNAME=dotfiles-migration \
            GOPATH=/home/dotfiles-migration/go GOCACHE=/home/dotfiles-migration/.cache/go-build \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/retirement.test" -test.v -test.timeout=15m -test.run='^TestNativeLegacyDeterminate(Upstream)?Retirement$'

  missing-apple-clt:
    name: Missing Apple developer tools (macOS arm64)
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Prepare missing Apple tools while retaining Homebrew on this disposable runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" = true
          test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
          test "$(go env GOHOSTOS)/$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = darwin/arm64
          test -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go -C installer test -c -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" .
          baseline="$RUNNER_TEMP/preinstalled-apple-tools"
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES=1 DOTFILES_TEST_APPLE_CLT=1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" -test.v -test.timeout=5m -test.run='^TestNativeAppleCLTPreinstalledReuse$'
          # Inspect payload files, not receipt directory records, before moves.
          receipts="$(pkgutil --pkgs)"
          outside="$baseline/outside-receipt-paths.txt"
          (umask 077; set -C; : > "$outside")
          while IFS= read -r receipt; do
            case "$receipt" in
              com.apple.pkg.CLTools*)
                info="$(pkgutil --pkg-info "$receipt")"
                printf '%s\n' "$info"
                printf '%s\n' "$info" | /usr/bin/awk -F': ' -v package="$receipt" '
                  $1 == "package-id" {if ($2 != package) exit 1; ids++}
                  $1 == "volume" {if ($2 != "/") exit 1; volumes++}
                  $1 == "location" {if ($2 != "/") exit 1; locations++}
                  END {if (ids != 1 || volumes != 1 || locations != 1) exit 1}'
                members="$(pkgutil --only-files --files "$receipt")"
                printf '%s' "$members" | /usr/bin/awk -v outside="$outside" '
                  {
                    n=split($0, parts, "/")
                    valid=length($0)>0 && length($0)<=4096 && substr($0,1,1)!="/"
                    for (i=1;i<=n;i++) if (parts[i]=="." || parts[i]==".." || parts[i]=="") valid=0
                    if (valid) {
                      if ($0 !~ /^Library\/Developer\/CommandLineTools\//) print "/" $0 >> outside
                      next
                    }
                    invalid++
                    if (invalid <= 20) printf "CLT receipt has a noncanonical payload file: %.256s\n", $0 > "/dev/stderr"
                  }
                  END {
                    if (invalid > 20) printf "CLT receipt has %d additional invalid payload files\n", invalid-20 > "/dev/stderr"
                    if (invalid) exit 1
                  }
                '
                ;;
            esac
          done <<< "$receipts"
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES=1 DOTFILES_TEST_APPLE_CLT=1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" -test.v -test.timeout=5m -test.run='^TestNativeAppleCLTRecordOutsideReceiptPreservation$'
          # Historical receipts remain unchanged; only payloads move aside.
          shopt -s nullglob
          for application in /Applications/Xcode*.app; do
            sudo mv "$application" "$baseline/"
          done
          if [[ -e /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools ]]; then
            sudo mv /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools "$baseline/"
          fi
          sudo xcode-select --reset
          unset DEVELOPER_DIR SDKROOT TOOLCHAINS
          if selected="$(LC_ALL=C xcode-select --print-path 2>&1)"; then exit 1; else status=$?; fi
          test "$status" = 2
          test "$selected" = $'xcode-select: error: Unable to get active developer directory. Use `sudo xcode-select --switch path/to/Xcode.app` to set one (or see `man xcode-select`)'
      - name: Install the advertised Apple tools and compile an SDK program
        working-directory: installer
        shell: bash
        env:
          DOTFILES_TEST_NATIVE_PACKAGES: '1'
          DOTFILES_TEST_APPLE_CLT: '1'
        run: '"$RUNNER_TEMP/installer.test" -test.v -test.timeout=35m -test.run="^TestNativeAppleCLTMissingPayloadWithExistingHomebrew$"'

  fresh-windows-vendor:
    name: Fresh Windows vendor (${{ matrix.recipe }})
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 85
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - recipe: VC-runtime
            test: TestWindowsVendorNativeOwnedLifecycle
            flag: DOTFILES_NATIVE_WINDOWS_VENDOR_INSTALL
          - recipe: Build-Tools
            test: TestWindowsBuildToolsNativeOwnedLifecycle
            flag: DOTFILES_NATIVE_WINDOWS_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALL
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      # Distinct fresh containers prevent Build Tools from preinstalling the
      # runtime before its separate fresh/changed-version lifecycle assertion.
      WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/framework/runtime:4.8-windowsservercore-ltsc2022@sha256:3983348680840ca6e53ad641e314c3c9184ca2fd19f88bc467600f7d9f6e9d73
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.1
          cache: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go.sum
      - name: Prepare the disposable Windows container engine
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ($env:GITHUB_ACTIONS -ne 'true' -or $env:RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT -ne 'github-hosted') { throw 'Disposable runner required' }
          if ((go env GOHOSTOS) -ne 'windows' -or (go env GOHOSTARCH) -ne 'amd64') { throw 'Native Windows amd64 required' }
          Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='docker'" |
            Select-Object State, StartMode, ProcessId, ExitCode, ServiceSpecificExitCode | Format-List
          $service = Get-Service -Name docker -ErrorAction Stop
          $timer = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
          $probeDirectory = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('docker-readiness-' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $probeDirectory | Out-Null
          $stdout = Join-Path $probeDirectory 'stdout'
          $stderr = Join-Path $probeDirectory 'stderr'
          $lastOutput = 'No Docker API response'
          try {
            if ($service.Status -eq 'Stopped') { Start-Service -Name docker -ErrorAction Stop }
            while ($true) {
              $service.Refresh()
              if ($service.Status -notin @('Running', 'StartPending')) { throw "Docker service stopped or cannot start: $($service.Status)" }
              $remaining = 60000 - $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds
              if ($remaining -le 0) { throw "Windows Docker API readiness expired: $lastOutput" }
              $probe = Start-Process docker -ArgumentList @('--host', 'npipe:////./pipe/docker_engine', 'version', '--format', '{{.Server.Os}}') `
                -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $stdout -RedirectStandardError $stderr
              try {
                if (-not $probe.WaitForExit([int]$remaining)) {
                  $probe.Kill()
                  $probe.WaitForExit()
                  throw 'Windows Docker API readiness query timed out'
                }
                $exitCode = $probe.ExitCode
                $output = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($stdout).Trim()
                $lastOutput = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($stderr).Trim()
              } finally { $probe.Dispose() }
              if ($exitCode -eq 0) {
                if ($output -cne 'windows') { throw "Native Windows container engine required; received '$output'" }
                if ($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds -ge 60000) { throw 'Windows Docker API readiness expired' }
                break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
            }
            Write-Output "Windows Docker API ready after $($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds) ms"
          } catch {
            Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='docker'" |
              Select-Object State, StartMode, ProcessId, ExitCode, ServiceSpecificExitCode | Format-List
            Write-Output "Last Docker API diagnostic: $lastOutput"
            throw
          }
      - name: Compile fixture and verify the disposable Windows container engine
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ($env:GITHUB_ACTIONS -ne 'true' -or $env:RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT -ne 'github-hosted') { throw 'Disposable runner required' }
          if ((go env GOHOSTOS) -ne 'windows' -or (go env GOHOSTARCH) -ne 'amd64') { throw 'Native Windows amd64 required' }
          if ((docker info --format '{{.OSType}}') -ne 'windows') { throw 'Native Windows container engine required' }
          $fixture = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'vendor-native'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $fixture | Out-Null
          $env:CGO_ENABLED = '0'
          go -C installer test -c -o (Join-Path $fixture 'installer.test.exe') .
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native fixture compilation failed' }
          docker pull $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Pinned Windows test image unavailable' }
      - name: Time the first containers after the image pull (diagnostic only)
        # Evidence for the intermittent Build Tools first-inspection timeout
        # (2026-10-23). A separate container timed after the lifecycle was fast
        # (first WMI query under 0.6 s), so this runs first: the first
        # PowerShell container after the pull, a bare container, then a second
        # PowerShell container. It cannot fail the job. The lifecycle then no
        # longer starts the first container after the pull, as in the
        # VC-runtime job, whose Python check already runs first.
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $nt = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
          Write-Output "host: image=$env:ImageVersion build=$($nt.CurrentBuild).$($nt.UBR)"
          $probe = @'
          $timer = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
          $nt = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
          $registry = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds
          $null = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem
          $first = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds - $registry
          $mark = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds
          $null = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem
          $second = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds - $mark
          $mark = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds
          $null = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath (Join-Path ([Environment]::SystemDirectory) 'kernel32.dll')
          $signature = $timer.ElapsedMilliseconds - $mark
          "container: build=$($nt.CurrentBuild).$($nt.UBR) to_registry_ms=$registry cim_first_ms=$first cim_second_ms=$second authenticode_ms=$signature winmgmt=$((Get-Service winmgmt).Status)"
          '@
          $encoded = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($probe))
          $powershell = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
          $timer = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
          docker run --rm --isolation=process --memory 4g $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE `
            $powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand $encoded
          Write-Output "first PowerShell container total: $($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds) ms (exit $LASTEXITCODE)"
          $timer.Restart()
          docker run --rm --isolation=process $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE cmd.exe /d /c exit 0
          Write-Output "bare container start and exit: $($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds) ms (exit $LASTEXITCODE)"
          $timer.Restart()
          docker run --rm --isolation=process --memory 4g $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE `
            $powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand $encoded
          Write-Output "second PowerShell container total: $($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds) ms (exit $LASTEXITCODE)"
      - name: Verify Python with the default Windows path policy
        if: matrix.recipe == 'VC-runtime'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $fixture = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'vendor-native'
          docker run --rm --isolation=process --memory 4g --storage-opt size=10G `
            --mount "type=bind,source=$fixture,target=C:\fixtures,readonly" `
            --env DOTFILES_TEST_ARCHIVES=1 --env DOTFILES_TEST_LANGUAGE_PREPARATION=1 `
            --env DOTFILES_TEST_PYTHON_DEFAULT_WINDOWS=1 `
            --workdir C:\fixtures --entrypoint C:\fixtures\installer.test.exe `
            $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE '-test.v' '-test.timeout=15m' '-test.run=^TestNative(ArchiveWindowsPythonDefaultPaths|LatexPreparationLifecycleAndStablePython|YamllintPreparationLifecycleAndStablePython)$'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Default Windows Python lifecycle failed' }
      - name: Verify fresh install, update, repair and exact removal
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $fixture = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'vendor-native'
          docker run --rm --isolation=process --memory 4g --storage-opt size=60G `
            --mount "type=bind,source=$fixture,target=C:\fixtures,readonly" `
            --env GITHUB_ACTIONS=true --env RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted `
            --env DOTFILES_NATIVE_WINDOWS_VENDOR=1 --env '${{ matrix.flag }}=1' `
            --workdir C:\fixtures --entrypoint C:\fixtures\installer.test.exe `
            $env:WINDOWS_TEST_IMAGE '-test.v' '-test.timeout=70m' '-test.run=^${{ matrix.test }}$'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native vendor lifecycle failed' }
